recommendations.title: Deploy Prerender.io or enable SSR to fix JavaScript rendering
recommendations.description: Deploy Prerender.io middleware or configure Next.js SSR on top of Venia PWA. This makes the site fully crawlable by search engines and dramatically improves mobile load speed by serving pre-rendered HTML.
success_metrics: Google Search Console — all pages indexed

recommendations.title: Add trust strip above-fold on all pages
recommendations.description: Add a horizontal trust bar visible on every page: Free Delivery 199+ SAR | 30-Day Returns | 45 Years of Quality | Secure Checkout. This reduces purchase anxiety and improves conversion from first-time visitors.
success_metrics: A/B test: measure checkout initiation rate before/after
Heatmap: confirm strip is seen by 80%+ of visitors

recommendations.title: Enable image optimization — WebP conversion and lazy loading
recommendations.description: Convert all product images to WebP format (50-80% smaller than JPEG). Enable lazy loading for images below the fold. Implement responsive images with srcset. Configure Magento's image optimization pipeline.

recommendations.title: Enable guest checkout and optimize checkout flow
recommendations.description: Remove mandatory account creation before purchase. Implement guest checkout as the primary option with optional post-purchase account creation. Reduce checkout to maximum 3 steps.

recommendations.title: Integrate Tamara and Tabby BNPL payment options
recommendations.description: Install Tamara and Tabby Magento extensions. BNPL is now standard in KSA e-commerce. Display 'Pay in 4 with Tamara' messaging on product pages and cart to increase AOV on premium thobes (249-599 SAR range).
success_metrics: AOV on BNPL orders vs standard

recommendations.title: Configure abandoned cart email and SMS recovery sequence
recommendations.description: Implement a 3-touch abandoned cart recovery sequence: Email at 1 hour (reminder), Email/SMS at 6 hours (value reinforcement), Email at 24 hours (incentive offer — e.g., 10% off). Use Klaviyo or Dotdigital for MENA market.

recommendations.title: Add sticky 'Add to Cart' button on mobile product pages
recommendations.description: Implement a fixed bottom bar on mobile that shows product name, price, and an 'Add to Cart' CTA. This removes the need to scroll back up to add to cart — a critical mobile UX improvement.
success_metrics: Scroll depth on mobile product pages

recommendations.title: Install heatmap and session recording tools
recommendations.description: Install Microsoft Clarity (free) or Hotjar to capture real user behavior — heatmaps, scroll maps, and session recordings. This data will validate and refine all subsequent UX decisions with evidence rather than assumptions.
success_metrics: Data collection active across all key pages
First heatmap insights reviewed within 2 weeks

recommendations.title: Implement customer review platform
recommendations.description: Integrate Stamped.io, Yotpo, or Judge.me with the Magento store. Display aggregate star ratings on product listing pages. Enable review filtering by 'Fit,' 'Quality,' and 'Delivery' on product pages. Send automated post-purchase review request emails.
success_metrics: Average product rating visible on listing pages
Conversion rate lift on reviewed products vs unreviewed

recommendations.title: Build interactive size guide and fit calculator
recommendations.description: Create a dedicated size guide page for each garment category (thobes, shirts, trousers). Build an interactive 'Find My Size' calculator where customers input height, weight, and chest measurement to get a size recommendation. Add size guide link on all product pages. Reduces returns by 20-30%.
success_metrics: Return rate reduction on sized items
Add-to-cart rate on products with size guide

recommendations.title: Implement advanced faceted filtering and search
recommendations.description: Deploy Elasticsearch with Magento (Elastic Suite or Algolia). Enable filtering by: Occasion (Daily/Formal/Wedding/Ramadan), Fabric (Cotton/Polyester/Wool), Style (Saudi/Emirati/Omani), Size, Color, Price Range. Add search autocomplete, synonyms ('thobe' = 'thawb'), and zero-results handling.

recommendations.title: Commission enhanced product photography
recommendations.description: For top 50 SKUs: shoot 6-8 images per product including: flat lay, front on-model, back on-model, collar/sleeve detail, fabric close-up, and lifestyle context shot. Include model shots that show traditional Saudi male styling (ghutrah, agal). This is the highest-impact content investment for apparel conversion.
success_metrics: Conversion rate on re-photographed products vs baseline

recommendations.title: Redesign mobile navigation with bottom tab bar
recommendations.description: Replace hamburger-only navigation with a persistent bottom tab bar for mobile: Home | Categories | Search | Wishlist | Account. Add a slide-in filter drawer accessible from a fixed button. Ensure all touch targets are 44×44px minimum. Add one-tap WhatsApp support button visible on every page.

recommendations.title: Add urgency and scarcity signals
recommendations.description: Implement: 'Only X left in your size' low-stock warnings (trigger at ≤5 units), 'Y people viewing this product' social proof, delivery date estimate ('Order today, delivered by Thursday'), and countdown timers on promotional pages.
success_metrics: Conversion rate on urgency-shown vs control products (A/B test)

recommendations.title: Write SEO category page content (Arabic and English)
recommendations.description: Write 150-200 word editorial introductions for top 10 category pages in both Arabic and English. Add FAQ sections ('What is the difference between a Saudi and Emirati thobe?'). Implement structured data (Schema.org/Product) for rich snippets. Write meta titles and descriptions for all category and product pages.
success_metrics: Click-through rate from Google Search Console
Category page ranking for target keywords

recommendations.title: Add fabric and product details panel on product pages
recommendations.description: Create a tabbed information panel below the add-to-cart section showing: Fabric Composition (e.g., 100% Egyptian Cotton), GSM/Weight, Season Suitability (Summer/Winter/All-season), Care Instructions, Country of Origin, Collar Style, Sleeve Length. This information is critical for thobe purchase decisions.

recommendations.title: Implement CDN and edge caching
recommendations.description: Deploy Fastly or AWS CloudFront as CDN with edge nodes in KSA/UAE (Riyadh, Dubai). Configure full-page caching for static and semi-static pages. Implement Varnish caching for Magento. Target TTFB < 400ms for GCC users.

recommendations.title: Add 'Complete the Look' cross-sell on product pages
recommendations.description: Add a 'Complete the Look' section below the product description showing curated accessory pairings: thobes paired with ghutrah, agal, and belt options. This drives AOV lift by surfacing complementary products in a contextually relevant way. Target: 15-20% of product page visitors engage with cross-sell.

recommendations.title: Implement full server-side rendering (Next.js or Nuxt.js)
recommendations.description: Migrate from client-side-only Venia PWA to a full SSR implementation using Next.js (React) or Nuxt.js (Vue) as the frontend layer, connected to Magento via GraphQL API (headless commerce). This is the definitive fix for all Core Web Vitals and SEO issues.

recommendations.title: Deploy AI-powered personalization engine
recommendations.description: Integrate Nosto, Algolia Recommend, or Adobe Sensei for real-time personalization. Returning customers see recently viewed items and recommendations based on purchase history. New visitors see bestsellers. Implement personalized email product recommendations. Target: 15-25% of revenue from recommended products.

recommendations.title: Launch editorial content hub — 'The Saudi Style Guide'
recommendations.description: Create a blog/editorial section targeting high-intent organic search terms. Content pillars: (1) Style guides ('How to dress for Eid'), (2) Fabric education ('The complete guide to thobe fabrics'), (3) Occasion guides ('What to wear for Saudi National Day'), (4) Care guides. Produce 2 articles/week in Arabic, 1/week in English.
success_metrics: Time on site from organic visitors

recommendations.title: Full homepage campaign-quality redesign
recommendations.description: Redesign the homepage to deliver a premium, editorial brand experience. Implement: campaign-quality seasonal hero with parallax, bestseller bar, brand story section, curated category tiles, user-generated content (Instagram feed), editorial lookbook feature, trust indicators, and newsletter signup. Align with Saudi cultural calendar (Eid, Ramadan, National Day).

recommendations.title: Launch loyalty programme
recommendations.description: Design and implement a loyalty programme: earn points on purchases, birthday rewards, Ramadan-exclusive benefits, early access to new collections. Use Smile.io or Yotpo Loyalty (Magento compatible). Target: 30% increase in repeat purchase rate within 6 months of launch.

recommendations.title: Enable PWA home screen install and push notifications
recommendations.description: Configure the Venia PWA to prompt home screen installation on mobile after 3+ page views. Implement push notification campaigns for: new arrivals, price drops, and abandoned cart (as a supplement to email). GDPR/PDPL-compliant opt-in flow. Target: 5-10% of mobile users install the PWA.
